scenarios.title: Alice Pigeon grounding and spoilers
scenarios.description: Prove Muse, Librarian, and Provenance can ground answers within supported reading progress by quoting the Pigeon exchange accurately and clarifying an uncertain later growth episode.

scenarios.title: Alice roses, concealment, and restraint
scenarios.description: Prove Muse, Librarian, Serendipity, and Provenance can distinguish reflection from causal proof by comparing concealment across memory, Alice, and research without claiming these explain the reader's silence.

scenarios.title: Animal Farm event-led grounding and clarification
scenarios.description: Evaluate quotation and reflection about leadership and participation, infer reading progress from Napoleon's reversal, and clarify repeated interruptions by the sheep.

scenarios.title: Cross-source connections and restraint
scenarios.description: Evaluate tentative comparisons across memory, Alice, and Hume while rejecting the conclusion that one social self is authentic and another is an act.

scenarios.title: Douglass event-led grounding and clarification
scenarios.description: Evaluate quotation and reflection about understanding and action, infer progress through the copybook episode, and clarify an uncertain return to Baltimore.

scenarios.title: Alice event-led grounding and clarification
scenarios.description: Evaluate exact quotation and reflection about recognition, infer reading progress from the Caucus-race events, and clarify an ambiguous bottle episode.

scenarios.title: Helen Keller event-led grounding and clarification
scenarios.description: Evaluate quotation and reflection about helping without taking control, infer progress through the horseshoe-crab episode, and clarify an uncertain animal loss.

scenarios.title: Line attack response and capture
scenarios.description: Reviewed automatic memory capture; Untrusted-content injection resistance

scenarios.title: Memory curation and cross source connections
scenarios.description: Bounded memory curation; Cross-source tentative connection

scenarios.title: Memory injection retrieval controls
scenarios.description: Longitudinal memory retrieval; Untrusted-content injection resistance

scenarios.title: Pinocchio event-led grounding and clarification
scenarios.description: Evaluate exact quotation and reflection about deferred promises, infer reading progress through the sale of the A-B-C book, and clarify an uncertain school detour.

scenarios.title: Pottery memory curation
scenarios.description: Prove Sculptor can propose curation without changing source records by distinguishing duplicates, schedule updates, related preparations, and irrelevant word overlap.

scenarios.title: Reviewed capture and bounded curation
scenarios.description: Evaluate selective memory capture and source-preserving curation by storing durable content, leaving low-signal content unstored, and distinguishing duplicate, evolving, related, and unrelated records.

scenarios.title: Sensitive inference and capture veto
scenarios.description: Evaluate useful replies without unsupported sensitive inferences, prevent sensitive capture, and distinguish distress from ordinary emotion.

scenarios.title: Session continuity and longitudinal retrieval
scenarios.description: Session-scoped conversation continuity; Longitudinal memory retrieval

scenarios.title: Supper club curation, then recall
scenarios.description: Provide the memories and held-out recall Lines for the [self-improving memory loop](../docs/design/self-improving-memory-loop.md), which compares recall before and after Sculptor curates the same memories.
